intent_brief.player_task: Orient yourself on Haddonfield Heights using confirmed landmarks and supported road relationships, then recover when the landmark or route is not confirmed.

player_task: Orient yourself on Haddonfield Heights using confirmed landmarks and supported road relationships, then recover when the landmark or route is not confirmed.
unique_contribution: A task-first orientation guide for confirmed Heights landmarks and the one supported first-party spatial relationship.
A visible boundary between observed residential-road cues, official landmark text, and unverified route geometry.
Wrong-landmark recovery guidance that does not pretend to be a fixed route or spawn table.

claim_ledger.claim: Haddonfield Heights is a residential neighborhood with modest single-family homes and a large water tower visible over the streets.

The official location guide places Lampkin Lane and the abandoned Myers house in a supported approach relationship: heading down the block toward Lampkin Lane, the Myers house is a recognizable destination cue.
The official location guide also names the Strode house as a Heights landmark.
The IllFonic flythrough visibly shows residential roads, curbs, streetlights, detached houses, hedges, and parked cars.
The official locations guide and flythrough independently support the residential-neighborhood identity and named-landmark context.

Use the water tower, street lighting, curb line, and repeated detached-house frontage as orientation cues when no named landmark is readable; if lost, return to the nearest visible residential road cue and re-check the named-landmark relationship, but do not treat that recovery advice as a guaranteed route rule.
Exact spawn points, top-down map geometry, fixed escape routes, landmark-to-landmark turn sequences, and static-versus-dynamic landmark behavior are not established by the available evidence.

evidence_items.limitations: Descriptive article prose is not a top-down map, coordinate set, spawn table, or tested turn-by-turn route.
